body: Yeah, I think we should just not set them to `null` ... ever :).  Especially not in `channelInactive`, that's just too early.  If we wanted to set them to `null`, `handlerRemoved` might be more appropriate.  @Scottmitch  WDYT?

> Yeah, I think we should just not set them to null ... ever :).

Agreed. This is not necessary, and if is causing problems can be removed.
Ok cool ... I'll send a PR out shortly.

@Scottmitch seems easy enough ... might be faster if I do it (no legal involved) ... your call.

issue.title: Don't set HTTP/2 flow controller ctx to null

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
Motivation:

We currently set the flow controller ChannelHandlerContexts to null when the channel becomes inactive. This is bad :)

Modifications:

Just remove that code in Http2ConnectionHandler

Result:

Fixes #4240
